fields.label: Résumé
fields.note: A display:none file input inside its drop zone label[data-testid=resume] (the adapter's upload control), titled by its field's label span and required by the star span after it.

fields.label: Phone number country code
fields.note: The phone's code (aria-label "Search" alone): titled by the phone field's label with "country code" after it. Its list is in no snapshot: the person's.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: Rippling draws the box on the input's wrapper (div.css-1mlcsw inside div[data-testid=<key>], a 1 px border and 16 px padding, 17 px beyond the input's sides), which holds the input and nothing else but decoration: its content box hugs them, so it is the input's box (dom/camouflage.ts drawnByWrapper, core pass Z2 of 2026-11-06; read camouflaged until then). (Location's search icon also sits in that wrapper.)

fields.label: Cover letter
fields.note: The cover letter's drop zone, as the résumé's; no star.

fields.label: Are you legally authorized to work in the United States of America?
fields.note: A custom Yes/No question, a combobox whose own name is aria-label "Select": titled by its block's p. Its list is in no snapshot: the person's.

fields.label: Check Yes or No to indicate your agreement to receive text message updates from Qu Pos, Inc. regarding your job application. Frequency may vary. Message and data rates may apply. Reply HELP for assistance. Reply STOP to opt out of future messaging.
fields.note: The SMS consent: a radiogroup of div[role=radio] (aria-checked) over display:none native radios, declared a radio widget (its members the drawn radios), titled by the paragraph before its field.
